title: The roster opens before recent activity
summary: Give a slow shared roster time to recover and load recent activity only after the core app is ready.
changes: A realistic startup window for a slow or cold shared database connection.
Recent activity history that can no longer block entry to Night, Changes or Breaks.
Retry and an explicitly read-only saved-roster fallback while the shared connection is unavailable.
No changes to roster, staffing, allocation, Pager, Reliever, realtime, privacy or database rules.
